reasoning: The icon depicts a wireframe globe (commonly understood as web/internet) with a picture-in-picture or mini-window badge in the upper right. While intended for web picture-in-picture or web embeds, most users will read it broadly as a website or web app icon, though the tiny square modifier is hard to parse at list sizes and easily confused with a plain globe.
